name: Orchard
summary: NSL retail spine — mall density, tourist footfall, and condo/serviced edges with shorter CBD hops than far-east towns.
body: Orchard is the shortlist when North-South Line retail gravity and door-to-mall living matter more than quiet heartland texture. Housing is mostly condo and serviced-apartment stock rather than HDB grids; weekend tourist crowds and late retail energy are the tax. Expats land here for car-light CBD/Orchard hops and lifestyle density, not cul-de-sac calm. Compare with Somerset for a slightly tighter theatre/mall pocket, Dhoby Ghaut for multi-line interchange optionality, and River Valley when you want nightlife adjacency without the full tourist crush.
bestFor: car-light workers who want mall and CBD proximity
households okay with weekend tourist crowds
renters comparing serviced vs proper TA nearby
people who will book ActiveSG studios instead of trusting condo MPH rooms
watchOuts: Weekend tourist and mall peak crowds
Parcel locker / mailroom variance by estate
housingMix: Dense condo and serviced-apartment stock with limited quiet HDB texture.
commuteNotes: North-South Line at Orchard; test a Saturday afternoon Orchard Road walk before you romanticise the spine.
